articles.title: Genesis World 1.0 Launches as Open-Source Robotics Simulation Platform — Removes the 1x Physical World Speed Bottleneck
articles.summary: Genesis AI released Genesis World 1.0, an open-source simulation platform that eliminates the physical world's 1x speed constraint on robotics training. The platform runs full-physics simulations including fluids, cloth, and dexterous manipulation far faster than physical experiments allow, enabling scale that physical robotics research cannot.

DeepSWE Benchmark Shows GPT-5.5 Hitting 70% on Long-Horizon Software Engineering — Beating GPT-5.4 at 56% and Claude Opus 4.7 at 54%
articles.summary: Datacurve launched DeepSWE, a new coding benchmark designed around long-horizon software engineering tasks that older benchmarks couldn't capture. GPT-5.5 leads at 70%, followed by GPT-5.4 at 56% and Claude Opus 4.7 at 54% — a 14-point gap that was invisible in simpler benchmarks.

Triomics Raises $22M to Bring Oncology-Specific AI to Cancer Centers Nationwide
articles.summary: Triomics raised $22 million to deploy AI models specifically designed for the oncology workflow, not general-purpose models. The company builds AI trained on the complex data of cancer care — pathology reports, genomic sequences, treatment histories — for deployment in cancer centers.

articles.title: Baseten Raising $1 Billion at $11 Billion Valuation — More Than Doubled from $5 Billion Just Three Months Ago
articles.summary: Inference provider Baseten is raising $1 billion at an $11 billion valuation, more than doubling its $5 billion valuation from three months prior. The rapid revaluation signals surging enterprise demand for managed AI inference infrastructure as production workloads scale.

Sakana AI's DiffusionBlocks Enables Block-Wise Neural Network Training — Eliminates Need to Hold Entire Network in Memory
articles.summary: Sakana AI introduced DiffusionBlocks, a block-wise neural network training approach using diffusion interpretation that eliminates the requirement to hold an entire neural network in memory during training. The method formally connects neural network optimization to diffusion processes, unlocking more scalable and memory-efficient training.
